note: Edit this file to change funded directions, quotas and intake limits. The page, the apply API and the AI reviewer all read it.

trial.zh: ≤ 24 卡时 · 3 天内跑通最小实验

full.zh: ≤ 200 卡时 · 2 周内交付完整结果

research.zh: 成果突出者长期给卡，邀请加入研究组
research.en: Standout work: long-term compute and a research-group invitation

zh.title: RSI 评测
zh.desc: 衡量研究 agent 能不能超过人写的基线。
examples: 把开源项目做成可复现的 RSI 任务
留出集、多种子与配对检验协议

en.title: RSI evaluation
en.desc: Measure whether research agents beat human-written baselines.
examples: Turn an open project into a reproducible RSI task
Held-out splits, multiple seeds, paired tests

zh.title: Harness 优化
zh.desc: 冻结模型权重，只改 agent 外层：提示、工具、上下文、恢复策略。
examples: 由失败轨迹驱动的 harness 搜索
改进能否跨模型、跨任务迁移

en.title: Harness optimization
en.desc: Frozen weights; change only the agent's outer loop: prompts, tools, context, recovery.
examples: Harness search driven by failure traces

zh.title: 后训练内化
zh.desc: 把 harness 学到的能力，通过蒸馏或强化学习写进权重。
examples: 去掉 harness 后能力保留多少

en.title: Post-training internalization
en.desc: Move what the harness learned into the weights via distillation or RL.
examples: How much survives without the harness

zh.title: 自动化科研
zh.desc: 研究 agent 自己提出、执行、验证实验。
examples: 研究结论的程序化验证器
实验选题与算力分配策略

en.title: Automated research
en.desc: Research agents that propose, run and verify experiments.

zh.title: 其他 RSI
zh.desc: 基础模型开发的任何一层：数据、系统、推理、垂直领域模型。

en.title: Other RSI
en.desc: Any layer of model development: data, systems, inference, vertical models.

review_gates.desc_zh: 研究对象是 AI 系统本身，属于所选方向。
review_gates.desc_en: The object of study is the AI system itself, within the chosen direction.

review_gates.desc_zh: 公开作品能说明你做得了这件事。
review_gates.desc_en: Public work shows you can do this.

review_gates.desc_zh: 公开仓库、固定版本、有报告过的数字。
review_gates.desc_en: Public repo, pinned version, a reported number.

review_gates.desc_zh: 问题清楚，指标由程序在指定数据上算出。
review_gates.desc_en: A clear question; a metric computed by a program on named data.

review_gates.desc_zh: 写清能改什么、什么冻结、和谁对照。
review_gates.desc_en: What may change, what stays frozen, what it is compared against.

review_gates.desc_zh: 没有伪造分数的路径，测试集不可见。
review_gates.desc_en: No path to forge scores; the test set stays hidden.

review_gates.desc_zh: 试跑放得进 24 卡时、3 天；成败都能观察到。
review_gates.desc_en: The trial fits 24 GPU-hours and 3 days; success and failure are both observable.

zh: 评测进程会执行候选代码，或日志可被改写，分数存在伪造路径
基线没有固定版本，无法复现
对照组和实验组用的不是同一份配置
指标依赖人工判断，比如“新颖性”
干活阶段能联网，或能看到最终测试集
en: The scorer executes candidate code or logs are writable, so scores can be forged
The baseline is not pinned and cannot be reproduced
Control and treatment do not share one frozen configuration
The metric needs human judgement, e.g. 'novelty'
The agent can reach the network or the final test set while working
